name: SST Conflict Resolution & Teamwork
summary: The "Conflict Resolution and Teamwork" content provides a virtual reality experience that helps users practice resolving conflicts and cooperating with others in various social situations. Users review each scenario, select the appropriate Emotion Robot, listen to others, express their opinions appropriately, and choose the response card that best matches the situation. Through repeated practice, users improve communication, conflict resolution, teamwork, and everyday social interaction.
